en: This is an old postcard with the front showing a black and white photograph of a peaceful landscape with a river, trees, and distant hills. Along the right border, printed vertically, is the text 'TORPSHAMMAR: UTSIGT FRÅN KAPELLET.' Handwritten text is also visible in Swedish. The reverse side has the title 'BREFKORT' in Swedish, with a green Swedish stamp, a postmark from 1902, and an address written in cursive.
